# statsmodels parity fixtures

Generated JSON reference outputs from `statsmodels` (and a few `scipy.stats`
functions) used by the Rust integration tests under `tests/parity_*.rs`.

**Do not edit by hand.** Regenerate with:

```bash
pip install statsmodels scipy numpy
python3 scripts/parity_statsmodels.py
```

Each file is one estimator on one dataset. Datasets are embedded directly in
the JSON, generated by a deterministic Park-Miller LCG so that the same seed
always yields the same `(x, y)` byte-for-byte. The Rust tests read the dataset
out of the JSON; no Rust-side RNG is needed.

See `docs/parity.md` for the full parity contract, tolerance policy, and audit
matrix.
